channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Medical chartered plane crashes near Ranchi with 7 onboard, rescue ops on​
item.description: According to the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), the Beechcraft King Air C90 (tail number VT-AJV) departed Ranchi around 7:07–7:11 pm for Delhi and lost communication at about 7:34 pm, roughly 23 minutes into the flight. A crash was later confirmed near Palamu/Kasiyatu forest area.

item.title: Dipika Kakar's 1.3 cm liver cyst causes severe pain amid cancer battle; celebrates 8th anniversary before hospitalisation
item.description: Dipika Kakar's health has once again left her family and fans concerned. After battling liver cancer for months, she has now been diagnosed with a cyst, for which she will undergo a procedure and will be admitted on Tuesday.

item.title: Rashmika Mandanna blushes as she arrives with Vijay Deverakonda in Udaipur; visuals of wedding mandap go viral
item.description: After Rashmika and Vijay announced their wedding, paparazzi began sharing the first glimpses of the couple's wedding venue on their Instagram pages.

item.title: From Global Events to Global Markets: How AI-Driven Cyber Risk Is Redefining Power
item.description: Cybersecurity expert Krutik Poojara explains how AI-driven threats and digital vulnerabilities in global events and supply chains have transformed cyber resilience into a critical pillar of national security and market stability.

item.title: Uproar over Sabarimala gold theft in Kerala Assembly, Oppn walks out demanding minister's resignation
item.description: Industries Minister P. Rajeev called the charges politically motivated and dared the opposition to move a no-confidence motion. Meanwhile, the Travancore Devaswom Board is under Kerala High Court scrutiny over accounting lapses linked to the Global Ayyappa meet.

item.title: India's GDP growth likely to cross 8 pc in Q3 FY26 despite global headwinds: SBI report
item.description: India's GDP growth is projected to reach 8–8.1% in Q3 FY26, according to an SBI Research report, driven by strong rural and urban consumption despite global uncertainties. The report highlights resilient domestic demand supported by fiscal stimulus.

item.title: Lucknow teen shoots father, dismembers body and hides remains in blue drum
item.description: A 19-year-old in Lucknow was arrested for allegedly shooting his father during a dispute over NEET-related career pressure, dismembering the body, and hiding the torso in a blue drum while dumping other parts elsewhere.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post early losses over AI-related tech woes
item.description: As of 9.26 am, Sensex lost 577 points, or 0.69 per cent, to reach 82,717, and Nifty dipped 161 points, or 0.63 per cent to settle at 25,552.

item.title: Delhi Police arrest Youth Congress chief Uday Bhanu Chib in AI Summit shirtless protest case
item.description: Delhi Police arrested Indian Youth Congress chief Uday Bhanu Chib over the shirtless protest at the India AI Impact Summit in Bharat Mandapam. He was detained after 15 hours of questioning and produced before Patiala House Court, with police alleging non-cooperation and citing sufficient evidence.

item.title: Musk lashes out at Anthropic as Pentagon summons AI company CEO Dario Amodei
item.description: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth met Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei over restrictions on its Claude AI in defence networks, warning the firm could face "supply chain risk" status for refusing to ease safeguards. Elon Musk also accused Anthropic of data theft, as the Pentagon considers partnerships with xAI and Google's Gemini.
